content:
In 2002 during speech addressed to George Bush Zhirinovsky threatened him with changing Earths orbit to affect the US climate and flood the entire country: 

#ufotwitter

"At night, our scientists will slightly change the gravitational field of the Earth, and your country will be under water. 24 fucking hours, and your entire country will be under water! Of the Atlantic and Pacific oceans. Who are you fucking playing with?"

Last year NASA scientists discovered that the construction of the Three Gorges dam in China has actually tilted Earth's, increasing daylight by half a millisecond, the dam reached for the first time it's full capacity in 2003… the US have suffered increasingly destructive hurricanes and floods for the last two decades.

Everything he said here is completely accurate: geophysical, ionospheric, and weather weapons are all  real, but he didn't mention one thing – the Americans possess the same knowledge, which is why no one has attacked each other for real yet.
